mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known as a crystal field."
The field produced is known as a crystal field.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to reactivity, generally, ligand substitution which occurs extremely rapidly in some cases and extremely slowly in others."
Kinetic stability refers to reactivity, generally, ligand substitution which occurs extremely rapidly in some cases and extremely slowly in others.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in treatment of arthritis."
Auranofin (gold complex) is used in treatment of arthritis.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very important model that explains the spectra properties of complexes based on electrostatic treatment of the bonding mode in complexes."
Crystal Field Theory is a very important model that explains the spectra properties of complexes based on electrostatic treatment of the bonding mode in complexes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are known as strong field ligands, and these ligands can be expected to give low-spin octahedral complexes with first-row metal ions."
Ligands that force electron pairing are known as strong field ligands, and these ligands can be expected to give low-spin octahedral complexes with first-row metal ions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to provide explanation for the spectra and magnetic properties of complexes."
Crystal Field Theory (CFT) is used to provide explanation for the spectra and magnetic properties of complexes.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the energetics and associated equilibrium constant for the reaction of an aquated metal ion with some other ligand (other than water)."
Thermodynamic stability often refers to the energetics and associated equilibrium constant for the reaction of an aquated metal ion with some other ligand (other than water).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the tendency of the atomic magnetic dipoles, due to quantum-mechanical spin angular momentum, in a material that is otherwise non-magnetic to align with an external magnetic field."
Paramagnetism is the tendency of the atomic magnetic dipoles, due to quantum-mechanical spin angular momentum, in a material that is otherwise non-magnetic to align with an external magnetic field.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a measure of the extent to which this complex will be formed or be transformed into another complex under stated conditions on reaching equilibrium."
Thermodynamic stability of a complex is a measure of the extent to which this complex will be formed or be transformed into another complex under stated conditions on reaching equilibrium.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those with two binding sites e.g. ethylenediamine (H2NCH2CH2NH2), oxalate (C2O4)2- etc."
Bidentate ligands are those with two binding sites e.g. ethylenediamine (H2NCH2CH2NH2), oxalate (C2O4)2- etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most common with metal centre having sp3d2 or d2sp3 hybridisation with bond angle 900."
Octahedral is the most common with metal centre having sp3d2 or d2sp3 hybridisation with bond angle 900.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in production of cream, food etc as preservative to trap any metal that may cause discoloration of the products."
EDTA is used in production of cream, food etc as preservative to trap any metal that may cause discoloration of the products.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very weak form of magnetism that is only exhibited in the presence of an external magnetic field."
Diamagnetism is a very weak form of magnetism that is only exhibited in the presence of an external magnetic field.
